translation_notes: the single term construction becomes an island in ordinary operand position inside the triple pattern: URIRef("http://example.org/derived") -> <http://example.org/derived>. Nothing else in the region touches RDF -- it is a read (graph.triples), and there is no island form for reading, so this is all the notation can reach

the string literal handed to _handle_derived_from("http://example.org/derived") stays a plain Python str: the callee is what turns it into a URIRef, so making it an island would change the argument's type

the mechanical draft had inserted the @prefix block in the middle of the parenthesised 'from nanopub import (' list, which is not valid ldpy; since no prefixed name is used in the region, all five draft declarations were simply dropped
context shim: nanopub_shim.py puts the Nanopublication/nanopub-py@05022dc4bc checkout on sys.path (the package is not installed); one added import line, identical on both sides

driver: the region is a test method whose 'self' is unused, so a None stand-in is passed.
